$comment: Hand-approved river names (HydroRIVERS has none). Keyed by mouth reach (HYRIV_ID). Names use IGN spelling (FUENTE: Instituto Geográfico Nacional de la República Argentina), chosen by the owner on 2026-10-01 over the earlier OpenStreetMap spelling; pipeline:ign-match's stem vote (data/work/ign-match/report.json) confirms the IGN name along each river's main stem. `slug` is the river's id (URLs, Mongo _id) and never changes once published, even if the name does; `aliases` are former names that search still finds. shortName/type are the name split at its first word. Approved by the project owner on 2026-09-30, IGN names on 2026-10-01; nine AIC subcuencas added on 2026-10-02. Owner rule (2026-10-09): a river runs where its IGN name runs (pipeline:named traces it along the IGN line); `sourceCheck` is the owner's expectation for where it starts (lake outlet by HydroLAKES id, not cut at a lake, or a confluence of IGN names), checked in data/work/named/report.json; `sourceReach` (with `sourceEvidence`) overrides the trace where the rule cannot see the IGN line, and is flagged in the report.

rivers.name: Río Negro
rivers.evidence: OpenStreetMap waterway name at 5/5 sample points along the mouth segment (pipeline:osm-names, candidate #1, 2026-09-30); IGN name 'Río Negro' on 100% of the 711 km stem that has an IGN candidate (pipeline:ign-match, 2026-10-01)
rivers.sourceEvidence: IGN 'Río Negro' covers the stem up to the Limay–Neuquén confluence (the area trace's source, 61546311). The IGN line rule stops at 61552568 because two runs of three reaches (61552469–61552437 and 61547097–61547064) have no IGN line within the 250 m buffer: IGN's Río Negro line runs 290–970 m from them across the braided valley (measured 2026-10-09, Albers). Override by the coding agent, 2026-10-09; flagged for the owner.

rivers.sourceEvidence: IGN 'Río Malleo' covers 86% of 61550450, whose upstream reach 61550075 lies mostly inside HydroLAKES 10575 (the owner's source lake). Between 61550450 and 61550632 three reaches (61550607, 61550606, 61550476) have IGN's Río Malleo line 51–1,062 m away, beyond the 250 m buffer, so the rule instead takes the 61550608 branch (Río Malleo 0.94; the reach above it, 61550507, 0.32). Override by the coding agent, 2026-10-09; flagged for the owner.
